changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The files of a running attempt's folder except its checkouts, so any server can rebuild the folder.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE review_attempt_input ( id uuid NOT NULL, workspace_id bigint NOT NULL, job_id uuid NOT NULL, attempt integer NOT NULL, run_id uuid NOT NULL, path varchar(1024) NOT NULL, sha256 varchar(64) NOT NULL, permissions varchar(9) NOT NULL, content bytea NOT NULL, created_at timestamp(6) with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT review_attempt_input_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_review_attempt_input_path UNIQUE (job_id, attempt, run_id, path), CONSTRAINT sfk_review_attempt_input_job FOREIGN KEY (job_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES review_job(id, workspace_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT sfk_review_attempt_input_workspace FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT ck_review_attempt_input_shape CHECK (attempt >= 0 AND length(path) > 0 AND sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') ); CREATE INDEX idx_review_attempt_input_job ON review_attempt_input (workspace_id, job_id, attempt);

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Erasure no longer waits for the server that wrote a copy: copies are erased in PostgreSQL, and each server removes its own folders.
